summary: Reproduced the MambaRadixCache compressed-edge split returning zero device indices for the fresh-prefill n-1 key, then verified the existing upstream candidate that snapshots and inserts an owned interior grid-boundary Mamba checkpoint for both legacy and UnifiedRadixCache no_buffer paths. The regression verifies that duplicate and stale state slots are freed and that prev_prefix_len preserves KV ownership. On the assigned MI350X, the actual cache returned 0 indices at the bare split and the exact 64-index GPU reference after an interior checkpoint.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ca858a3a4ab7/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_mamba_radix_cache_match.py -k 'n_minus_1 or tombstone or shared_prefix' -vv
tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, the actual MambaRadixCache split the checkpointed [1,2,3] edge for an n-1 [1,2] lookup and returned 0 device indices while retaining the leaf checkpoint for a full 3-token match.
15 legacy/unified cache contract tests passed, including n-1 interior-checkpoint reuse, tombstone revival, duplicate/stale state freeing, and KV ownership across the two inserts.
40 related Mamba cache and cache-registry tests passed.

Actual MambaRadixCache execution on AMD Instinct MI350X / ROCm 7.2: bare split hit 0, full leaf hit 3, checkpointed split hit 64, and returned GPU indices exactly equaled an independent torch.arange(64) reference.
Changed files have no whitespace errors and all changed Python modules compile.

gpu_evidence: ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0/HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 actual-cache probe ran on AMD Instinct MI350X with torch ROCm 7.2.26015; exact GPU prefix-index equality was asserted against torch.arange.
remaining_limitations: No FlyDSL or native C++ code changed. A full hybrid-Mamba model server run was not performed because no model weights were prepared for this job; validation covers the real cache implementations and scheduler/cache ownership contracts but not end-to-end model logits or latency. The candidate intentionally does not cover prompts shorter than one checkpoint grid, speculative decoding, ReplaySSM, int8 checkpoints, extra_buffer, SWA-mixed unified trees, or divergence before the deepest retained interior boundary.
